aboutGame.title: What is Servant of the Lake?
paragraphs: Servant of the Lake is a premium single-player point-and-click puzzle adventure developed by Rusty Lake. You work inside the Vanderboom estate, completing daily chores that gradually turn into surreal and unsettling challenges.
Set decades before Rusty Lake: Roots, the game combines room exploration, observation puzzles, hidden achievements, dark humor, and mysterious alchemical experiments across a three-day stay.

finalCta.title: Ready to Serve the Vanderbooms?
finalCta.description: From your first morning at the estate to its final secrets and hidden achievements, our spoiler-aware guides help you solve every task without losing the mystery.

footer.about: Servant of the Lake Wiki is an independent fan-made guide site for players exploring the Vanderboom estate. It covers day-by-day walkthroughs, puzzle solutions, achievements, secrets, and endings, and is not affiliated with Rusty Lake.
footer.description: Premium single-player point-and-click puzzle adventure set in the Vanderboom estate.
